integrity: Proof uses finite subspace-lattice Möbius inversion, explicit existence constructions and flag varieties. Nine exhaustive independent small-configuration comparisons are supporting tests and not infinite-family proofs. All verification and originality judgments are self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Framed point counts only, not module isomorphism classes. The geometric assertion applies to reduced exact-rank loci; the full representation scheme might be nonreduced. General quivers and relations beyond radical-square-zero are excluded. Priority against all specialized historical quiver counting work is not certified.
title: Joint top–socle census of square-zero local algebra representations
